<a id="amoeba_glyph_tl"></a>
### [`amoeba_glyph_tl`](../../../../src/data/element_glyphs.asm#L6) `$5406-$540D`

*data*

Eight amoeba frames, 16 bytes each: left and right top character. Animation copies them to $40-$41/$50-$51 (cells $3a-$3b) if $ff is 4 or more.

- **Read by:** [`animate_chars`](../screen/animation.md#animate_chars)
